Manager – Accounts & Finance

Job Location: Pune (Camp)

Industry: Real Estate / Construction / Promoter & Developer

Reporting to: Head – Finance / CFO

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced and technology-savvy Manager – Accounts & Finance to lead the Accounting, Financial Reporting, FP&A and Tax Compliance functions for a leading promoter, developer and construction group in Pune.

The role will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting, smooth monthly closing, effective tax compliance, robust MIS and FP&A support, and efficient utilisation of the organisation’s ERP system. The position will also lead and mentor the accounting team and drive process discipline, automation and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting & Financial Reporting

Lead day-to-day accounting operations across the group and ensure accuracy, completeness and timely recording of financial transactions.

Drive the monthly, quarterly and annual financial close process.

Review general ledger, reconciliations, provisions, accruals, revenue, costs, receivables, payables and other accounting schedules.

Ensure appropriate accounting treatment for construction projects, development activities, land transactions, project costs and related-party transactions.

Prepare and review financial statements and management reporting in accordance with applicable accounting standards.

MIS, FP&A & Business Support

Lead preparation of monthly MIS, project-wise profitability reports, budgets, forecasts, cash-flow projections and variance analysis.

Provide meaningful financial insights to management on project performance, costs, margins, working capital and cash flows.

Develop and improve management dashboards and analytical reports to support business decision-making.

Work closely with project, commercial, procurement and business teams to ensure timely and accurate financial information.

Tax & Statutory Compliance

Oversee direct and indirect tax compliance, including GST, TDS, Income Tax and other applicable statutory requirements.

Ensure timely filing of returns, payments, reconciliations and responses to tax/statutory queries.

Coordinate with external tax advisors, auditors and consultants wherever required.

Monitor changes in tax laws and assess their impact on the business.

ERP & Process Management

Take ownership of the ERP system from a finance and accounting perspective and ensure smooth and effective utilisation by the accounting and business teams.

Work with ERP teams/consultants to configure processes, improve controls and develop MIS reports.

Should have the ability to understand business requirements and design/define ERP-based MIS and reporting solutions.

Experience with ERP platforms such as Highrise, SAP or equivalent will be an advantage.

Drive standardisation, automation, internal controls and continuous improvement of finance processes.

Audit & Compliance

Coordinate statutory, tax and internal audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.

Maintain appropriate documentation and supporting schedules for audit and management review.

Strengthen financial controls and ensure compliance with internal policies and procedures.

Team Leadership

Lead, guide and motivate the accounting team to deliver accurate, timely and reliable financial information.

Allocate responsibilities, monitor performance and develop team capabilities.

Establish a process-oriented and accountability-driven culture within the finance function.

Required Skills & Competencies

In-depth knowledge of accounting, financial reporting and month-end/year-end close processes.

Strong understanding of the real estate, construction, promoter and developer business, including project accounting and project-wise financial analysis.

Strong knowledge of FP&A, MIS, budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis.

Good understanding of GST, TDS, Income Tax and other statutory compliances relevant to the business.

Strong ERP knowledge with the ability to use technology for process improvement and MIS development.

Experience with Highrise, SAP or similar ERP systems will be preferred.

Technology-savvy and comfortable working with ERP, reporting tools, Excel and data-driven financial analysis.

Strong process orientation, attention to detail and analytical ability.

Excellent people-management, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables in a fast-paced business environment.

Qualification & Experience

Chartered Accountant (CA) with 5 years of post qualification experience or completion of CA article ship with 10 years of experience in leading the accounting/finance function.

Candidates with substantial experience in a real estate, construction, promoter or developer organization will be strongly preferred.

Proven experience in managing accounting teams and delivering monthly MIS, financial close, statutory compliance and management reporting.

Key Success Measures

Timely and accurate monthly financial close.

Quality and timeliness of MIS and management reporting.

Effective project-wise financial and cost reporting.

Timely statutory and tax compliance.

Smooth and effective ERP operations.

Strong financial controls and audit readiness.

Improved finance processes, automation and reporting.

Effective leadership and development of the accounting team.

Job Description
The Regional Head of Finance shall develop and lead his/her area of responsibility according to directives defined by the Group Finance and in compliance with laws and good practice.

Main tasks
• Oversee and develop the Indian companies accounting practices, including accounting departments, preparing budgets, financial reports, tax and audit functions.
• Implement and direct financial strategy, planning and forecasts; conferring with CEO, Managing directors and department heads.
• Develop improved reporting capabilities.
• Implement appropriate financial structure for the Group and its entities
• Supervise investments
• Study, analyze and report on trends, opportunities for expansion and projection of future company growth
• Financial and legal staff management; coaching, motivation, training and recruitment.

Type of responsibility
• Suggest appropriate structure from an operational and legal perspective.
• Ensure that the Region India fulfils the financial demands and targets imposed by the Group and other stakeholders.
• Support the development of tomorrow’s business and be involved in the company expansion, i.e. development of new markets, new countries and new areas of business
• Contributing to strategic planning and development as a member of Region India Management
• Corporate negotiations
• Communication with Group Finance, Board of Directors and Banks
• Accounts Management: Ensuring compliance to IGAAP. Responsible for monthly/quarterly/yearly closing & finalization. Expertise in accounting systems development, fiscal management and financial reporting. And Maintain books of accounts so as comply with Indian statutory standards and Company’s Business Practice norms.
Statutory Compliance(Taxation): Ensuring compliance and adherence of the various Corporate and Fiscal Laws, Statues, Enactments, Guidelines prevalent in India for Direct Taxes

( Income Tax, TDS,DTAA , Transfer pricing), Indirect taxes (Excise, Service Tax , VAT )

in all the transactions entered into by the organization and their assessment proceedings through sound knowledge of Indian Commercial laws, procedures and appropriate documentation.

• Budgeting / Budgetary Control: Formulating Revenue and Capital Budgets for the Business, conducting monthly appraisals of Actual Performance vs. Forecast, analyzing variance and suggesting corrective actions in case of negative variances.
• Costing: Responsible for the pricing/costing and cost control function of the Core Business. Suggesting management on capital budgeting, payback period of project.

Evaluate and implement strong Risks and Internal Controls Processes so as to ensure full compliance to corporate guidelines on prudent management principles. Handling of Corporate and Statutory Auditors
• Management Accounting: Handing the various management accounting functions viz.-Profitability Analysis, Financial planning & Analysis, MIS etc

• Support the business to meet the top line and bottom line objective

Indian GAAP, Taxation, Finance Controller, CA, Taxation Manufacturing, TDS, Taxes, Direct & Indirect Taxation, Treasury, Fund Management, CAPEX, IFRS

Education: (UG - Any Graduate - Any Specialization, B.Com - Commerce) AND (PG - CA)

• Preference: Local candidates; in-person interviews preferred.
• Fluent in English with good communication skills
• Punctual, professional, and responsible

Ways to Stand Out:
• Display genuine interest in accounting, taxation, and compliance.
• Be proactive and take ownership of assignments.
• Show strong client handling and deadline management skills.
• Maintain professionalism, discipline, and team spirit.

data.job_description:
About the Company: Devedaa Hospitality is a privately held US hotel investment and asset management firm based in Short Hills, NJ, self-managing a portfolio of three Marriott- and Hilton-branded properties across the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic. We are building a high-caliber India-based finance function to support our growing portfolio and are seeking a Marriott/Hilton-experienced chartered accountant to anchor and lead this team.

About the Role: Reporting to the US-based Director of Finance/Controller and VP of Operations, the Director of Finance will own end-to-end financial leadership for a three-property Marriott and Hilton portfolio — building and leading a team of 3–4 accounting professionals, serving as the day-to-day finance point of contact for property General Managers, supporting ownership reporting and calls, and establishing the SOPs, controls, and reporting standards for the India finance function. Must have current, hands on accounting experience.

This is a foundational, builder-track hire operating remotely from India in alignment with US Eastern Time Zone windows.

Reporting structure: The Director of Finance reports to the US-based Director of Finance/Controller and the VP of Operations. The India-based accounting team (3–4 FTEs) reports functionally into the Director of Finance, with day-to-day management and SOP ownership sitting with this role.

Key Responsibilities Team Leadership

• Hands on participation in all aspects of finance and accounting.

• Lead, manage, and develop a team of 3–4 accounting professionals supporting all three properties

• Build and refine India back-office SOPs, workflows, and controls for the accounting function

• Own hiring, performance management, and capability-building within the team as the portfolio grows Owner & GM Engagement

• Prepare consolidated owner-level financial packages (P&L;, balance sheet, cash flow) for review by the Controller and VP of Operations ahead of ownership discussions

• Participate in owner and GM review calls alongside the Controller/VP of Operations, providing financial detail, context, and analysis as needed

• Serve as secondary point of contact for property GMs on day-to-day financial questions and reporting matters, escalating to the Controller/VP of Operations on owner-facing or sensitive matters

• Proactively flag performance variances, risks, and opportunities to the Controller and VP of Operations ahead of owner conversations Financial Operations

• Own daily, monthly, and annual financial close across all three properties using M3 Accounting

• Process and review nightly FSPMS/PEP report drops; reconcile front-office to accounting systems

• Manage accounts payable, vendor reconciliation, and invoice processing

• Support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis in coordination with GMs and VP of Operations

• Liaise with US-based Controller on month-end, audits, and tax preparation support

• Monitor and enforce Marriott and Hilton franchise financial reporting standards and timelines

Required Qualifications

• 7+ years of hotel accounting experience, with direct Marriott and/or Hilton system exposure (FSPMS, PEP, M3, or the brands' internal financial reporting platforms)

• Chartered Accountant (CA) Credential

• 2+ years directly managing an accounting or finance team (hiring, performance management, workflow ownership)

• Comfort participating in owner and asset-management review calls (not solely brand/corporate reporting) — able to speak to financial detail and analysis in real time, even when not leading the conversation

• Prior experience at a Marriott or Hilton GCC, corporate shared services center, multi-property finance role, or managed hotel property in India (Marriott International or Hilton GCC alumni, or property-level Director of Finance background strongly preferred)

• Proficiency in M3 Accounting

• Strong command of US GAAP hotel accounting standards and Marriott and Hilton franchise reporting requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Commerce; CA / CMA / MBA Finance strongly preferred given seniority of role

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; ability to work independently and confidently across time zones with senior US stakeholders Preferred Qualifications

• Experience owning centralized/shared-services finance for a multi-property portfolio (not just processing within one)

• General awareness of US hotel ownership structures (LLC, franchise agreements, owner–operator relationships) is a plus, but not required — this is primarily owned by the US-based Controller • Prior exposure to Marriott or Hilton branded properties (Marriott, Autograph Collection, Sheraton, or Hampton Inn & Suites preferred) Portfolio

• Charleston Marriott Town Center — Charleston, WV (Marriott full-service, 352 keys)

• Trumbull Marriott Shelton — Shelton, CT (Marriott full-service)

• Hampton Inn & Suites Newark Airport Elizabeth — Elizabeth, NJ (Hilton select-service)

What We Offer

• Competitive compensation, commensurate with experience

• Fully remote from India with structured US ET overlap windows

• Direct exposure to US hotel ownership, asset management, and deal activity

- • Foundational, builder-track role — lead and grow the India finance function as the portfolio expands, with a transparent path to broader scope as Devedaa's US portfolio grows

Job Description: Accounts & Finance Manager (Chartered Accountant)

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Chartered Accountant to lead our Finance & Accounts function. The Accounts & Finance Manager will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of accounting, financial reporting, taxation, budgeting, treasury, statutory compliance, audits, and internal controls. The role requires strong analytical abilities, leadership skills, and a strategic mindset to support business growth while ensuring compliance with all applicable financial and regulatory requirements.

The ideal candidate should possess extensive knowledge of Indian accounting standards, direct and indirect taxation, financial planning and analysis, ERP systems, and corporate governance. The candidate will work closely with senior management to drive financial efficiency, improve business performance, and support strategic decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Accounting & Reporting

- Manage the complete accounting function and ensure accurate recording of all financial transactions.
- Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in compliance with applicable accounting standards.
- Ensure timely book closure and preparation of trial balance, profit & loss account, balance sheet, and cash flow statements.
- Review general ledger balances and perform account reconciliations.
- Monitor fixed assets, depreciation schedules, and capital expenditure accounting.
- Ensure timely month-end and year-end closing activities.

2. Taxation & Statutory Compliance

- Ensure complete compliance with GST, TDS, Income Tax, Professional Tax, and other applicable statutory regulations.
- Review and file GST returns, TDS returns, Income Tax returns, and other statutory filings within prescribed timelines.
- Handle tax assessments, departmental notices, and litigation support.
- Coordinate with tax consultants and legal advisors for compliance and advisory matters.
- Monitor changes in tax laws and assess their impact on the organization.
- Ensure timely payment of statutory dues and maintain proper documentation.

3. Audit & Internal Controls

- Lead statutory audits, internal audits, tax audits, and cost audits.
- Coordinate with external auditors and ensure timely completion of audits.
- Implement recommendations arising from audit findings.
- Develop and strengthen internal financial controls and SOPs.
- Ensure compliance with company policies and statutory requirements.
- Conduct periodic financial risk assessments and recommend mitigation measures.

4. Budgeting, Forecasting & Financial Planning

- Prepare annual operating budgets in consultation with department heads.
- Develop monthly and quarterly financial forecasts.
- Analyze budget versus actual performance and provide variance analysis.
- Support strategic financial planning and long-term business forecasting.
- Recommend cost optimization and profitability improvement initiatives.

5. Treasury & Cash Flow Management

- Monitor daily cash flow and liquidity requirements.
- Manage banking relationships and oversee fund management activities.
- Prepare cash flow forecasts and optimize working capital.
- Coordinate loan documentation, banking facilities, and financial instruments.
- Ensure efficient utilization of available funds.

6. MIS & Financial Analysis

- Prepare monthly MIS reports for senior management.
- Develop dashboards and KPI reports for business performance monitoring.
- Analyze profitability, margins, operating costs, and financial trends.
- Present financial insights to support strategic decision-making.
- Identify opportunities for revenue enhancement and cost reduction.

7. Accounts Payable & Receivable

- Monitor vendor payments and ensure timely settlement.
- Review customer receivables and coordinate collection activities.
- Ensure proper reconciliation of customer and vendor accounts.
- Improve receivable cycles and reduce outstanding balances.

8. ERP & Process Improvement

- Ensure effective utilization of ERP systems for finance operations.
- Participate in ERP implementation, upgrades, and process automation initiatives.
- Improve accounting processes through digitization and automation.
- Develop standardized financial procedures across business functions.

9. Team Management

- Lead, supervise, and mentor the finance and accounts team.
- Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance.
- Conduct regular performance reviews and training sessions.
- Foster a culture of accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement.

10. Business Support

- Provide financial support for new projects, investments, and expansion initiatives.
- Conduct financial feasibility studies and investment analysis.
- Support management during mergers, acquisitions, fundraising, or due diligence activities.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve operational efficiency.

Required Qualifications

- Chartered Accountant (CA) .
